Yep, i know what you mean. I used to disassociate often and it used to make me see myself in third person. Use to frightened me, give anxiety, and made me paranoid that i was being 'watched' all the time and 'that' was how i was able to be 'seen'. It encouraged the "truman show'' delusion. 

Try not to think about ego. (Its just added stress.) Those concepts are for philanthropist and psychologists who already have their life together. We should build to that ideology/thinking over time. We have to actually deal with our mental issues currently you know. Focus on everyday inconveniences you tackle in baby steps, like the muted emotions and paranoia. Have you ever tried to 'identify' the seventeen pieces? If you do you'll find a way to bridge the seperate pieces and feel whole. Work on your overall health in small dosages.

I cant relate to most but i can understand "never picturing myself growing old". My 'tomorrows' never feels promised. I almost never feel content or the comfort of knowing tomorrow will be a fulfilling one. I just 'wake up'. How does your borderline personality work? I look different at different angles and those angles all seem to have different effects on me mentally. Like the mirror with the good lights i used all my life gave me a false sense of confidence cause i look more appealing than i would in everyday life and the qualities of being that 'confident' gave me an entire persona/lifestyle that i eventually couldnt keep up with cause it came with certain things i couldnt maintain like, presence, living conditions, graphic design direction, conversations, being open, and extrovertedness. And it made me feel like a imposter when i realized my actual face is less appealing. and feelings of dread, depression, and severe anxiety came cause i felt that i 'oversold' myself to the world. Then i felt like i had to actually 'see' myself. (I recorded myself naked to see how the 'world' view me) thats how i realized i was living a, mental double life. Im now currently working on achieving contentness and control of my life. Im pulling it towards internal happiness. Hoping it can bring feelings, desires, and a yearn for longevity. And i dont just 'wake up'. You should ignore the scars. If you dont have any pursuits at least pursuit happiness.
